verdict.rationale: Wave ships built-in recurring-invoice scheduling and automated reminders (wave-docs-10, wave-docs-24, wave-docs-25), which is a genuine recurring-job capability, but this is a fixed in-app feature, not an extensible workflow/automation system an AI-native user could programmatically configure or trigger. The developer/API surface needed to build custom recurring jobs or agent-driven workflows is explicitly inaccessible (wave-supp-dev-portal-wall) and no CLI/webhook/MCP support is documented (wave-probe-1, wave-probe-2). Missing for 10: API-driven job scheduling, webhook/event triggers, and any AI-agent-facing automation interface beyond the built-in recurring invoice toggle.
